# SortableJS

Version 1.15.7, distributed under the [MIT license](LICENSE).

Source: [SortableJS/Sortable, tag 1.15.7](https://github.com/SortableJS/Sortable/tree/1.15.7).
`sortable.esm.js` is the unchanged upstream default ES module, including AutoScroll.

The module is served by Trama itself, with no CDN or runtime network requests.
It handles mouse and touch card reordering, scrolling and the movement animation.
Collection persistence and context actions remain in Trama's own modules.
